projects.title: Production Planning Software
projects.tagline: Turns daily dealer requirements into machine and mould schedules.
points: Reads the day's dealer requirements automatically.
Matches each order to a compatible mould and a free machine.
Shows a machine-wise schedule; whatever doesn't fit goes to a backlog.
Planners download the schedule to Excel.
projects.result: The daily plan comes from the app instead of being built in spreadsheets.

projects.title: Sales & Inventory Reporting
projects.tagline: Daily ETL from ERP data into region-wise reports on a web portal.
points: Scripts clean the daily ERP extracts and build report tables.
Reports: new launches, depot stock, leftover stock, category mix, plan vs. actual.
Each user logs in and sees only their own regions.
One-click Excel export, with product images inside.
projects.result: Reports are ready every morning without anyone building them by hand.

projects.title: Retail Chain Sales & Stock Planner
projects.tagline: Combines retail partner files and plans stock with ABC classes and trend rules.
points: Loads partner sales and purchase-order files into one database every day.
Dashboards by store, article, category and state, plus sales vs. target.
Stock planner: ABC class, trend (rising / flat / falling) and stock cover.
Generates ready-to-send order files with product thumbnails.
projects.result: Sales against target and replenishment are planned in one place, not by merging files.

projects.title: Purchase-Order Demand Forecasting
projects.tagline: Gradient-boosting model that predicts next month's order quantity per article.
points: Built 60+ features from past sales: lags and rolling averages, min, max and spread.
Compared XGBoost, LightGBM, gradient boosting and random forest, then combined the best.
Checked with 5-fold cross-validation and on a held-out month (MAE, RMSE, MAPE).
Built as research next to the rules-based planner; not yet wired into the app.
projects.result: Shows whether ML can beat the simple average-based planning before it is rolled out.

projects.title: Product Image Search Bot
projects.tagline: Chat-style search for product images, kept up to date by a nightly sync.
points: Type an article, colour or category and get the images, or upload a stock list.
Download results as images, Excel or a ZIP file.
Every night it checks cloud storage and downloads only new or replaced images.
Secure access: OTP email login and admin approval for new users.
Admin page shows top searches and images people looked for but didn't find.
projects.result: Sales teams find any product image in seconds; missing images are spotted from search logs.

projects.title: Stock Catalogue Generator
projects.tagline: Upload a stock list and get a picture catalogue with MRP as PDF, Excel or ZIP.
points: Matches each article in the uploaded list to its image and MRP.
Stamps the article code on each image.
Builds a PDF catalogue or an Excel file with images inside.
Emails a daily list of articles that have no image yet.
projects.result: A catalogue that needed manual lookups is made from a single upload.

projects.title: Power BI Sales Portal
projects.tagline: One portal that shows each user only the Power BI reports they're allowed to see.
points: Embeds Power BI reports inside a Flask web app.
Admin chooses which user sees which report, page and filter.
Uses DAX queries to fill filter menus and export data to Excel.
Logs activity and logs users out automatically.
projects.result: Users get their own view without needing a Power BI licence or workspace access.

projects.title: Product Launch Mailer
projects.tagline: Sends region-wise launch emails with product images from one spreadsheet.
points: Upload the launch sheet and the app attaches the right images.
Flags articles with missing images before anything is sent.
Sends each region its own HTML email.
Keeps a history of every launch sent.
projects.result: Launch mails go out the same way every time, with no broken images.

projects.title: Dealer Stock Allotment
projects.tagline: Splits limited stock across dealer orders using a scoring rule.
points: Scores each order on priority, inventory class and recent sales trend.
Labels each order green (full), red (partial) or black (hold).
Outputs the allotment file for the distribution team.
projects.result: The same fair rules are applied every day.

projects.title: Crypto Price Range & Direction Research
projects.tagline: Can 1-second market data predict short-term moves after fees? A careful test.
points: Data: a public exchange's 1-second spot and 1-minute futures history, plus live recording.
Volatility model (ridge regression) predicts how far the price can move.
Direction model (logistic regression) is only switched on if it beats chance on unseen data.
A small neural network written in plain NumPy tries to correct the linear model.
Leakage checks: shuffled-label placebo test and a synthetic no-signal test.
Walk-forward backtests with fees, plus a paper-trading dashboard (no real money).
projects.result: Price ranges were well calibrated, direction was close to chance, and nothing was profitable after fees. That negative result is reported honestly.
